youtube_description:
During Cosmopolitan UK’s Jordyn Woods interview, she spills the tea on new beauty ventures, empowering other women and sending love to social media trolls.
 
Jordyn Woods is only 21 years old, yet she's already launched her own line of activewear, starred in worldwide ad campaigns, and now she's travelling the globe to promote her brand new collaboration with Eylure Lashes. Not bad, huh?
 
But along with all the success, she's had a lot of drama to deal with, including the recent Tristan Thompson cheating scandal. Thankfully, Jordyn seems ready to move on from all that.
 
But there are some things Jordyn certainly has an opinion on, from how she turns trauma into self-love, to how she’s breaking into the beauty industry by starting her own YouTube channel and even getting into acting! Check out the video above to see her spill all the tea (both figuratively and literally).
 
Get the kettle on guys, this is going to be good.
